==Features and Overview==
==={{OoT|-}}===
{{Main|Forest Temple (Ocarina of Time)}}
The Forest Temple is the fourth [[Dungeon]], located at the far end of the [[Sacred Forest Meadow]] in {{OoT}}. Its main [[Item]] is the [[Fairy Bow]] and its [[Boss]] is [[Phantom Ganon]].

==={{TP|-}}===
{{Main|Forest Temple (Twilight Princess)}}
The Forest Temple is the first [[Dungeon]] in {{TP}}. It is located in [[N. Faron Woods]]. Its main [[Item]] is the [[Gale Boomerang]] and its [[Boss]] is [[Diababa]].

==={{ST|-}}===
{{Main|Forest Temple (Spirit Tracks)}}
The Forest Temple is the first [[Dungeon]] that [[Link]] must explore in order to restore its energy to the fragmented [[Tower of Spirits]] in {{ST}}. It is located in the northwestern [[Forest Realm]]. Its main [[Item]] is the [[Whirlwind]], and the Temple's [[Boss]] is [[Stagnox]].

==={{SS|-}}===
The Forest Temple is the area surrounding the [[Skyview Temple]] situated in the [[Deep Woods]]. Before Link can enter the Skyview Temple, he must find the [[Gemstone Switch]] within the Forest Temple area. The location of this Gemstone Switch is revealed by a [[Stone Tablet]] that is hidden in a patch of [[Grass]].<ref>{{Cite|He who descended from above: look to the star that the bird rising heavenward gazes upon, and aim your shot there.|Sign|SS}}</ref> A [[Tree Stump]] that Link can [[Sitting|Sit]] on to restore his [[Heart]]s can be found to the side of the entrance to the Skyview Temple. The door to the Skyview Temple has two crystals, located at the head and the tail. By shooting these crystals with the [[Slingshot]], [[Link]] can receive a [[Blue Rupee]] and a [[Green Rupee]], respectively. A single [[Bird Statue]] can be found at the Forest Temple.

After Link receives the [[Ruby Tablet]] at the [[Skyview Spring]], he is greeted by [[Machi]] in the Forest Temple area. Machi asks Link if he found Zelda.<ref>{{Cite|Hey! It's me, kwee! Did you find the girl?|Machi|SS}}</ref> Upon hearing that she is still missing, Machi offers that Link at least knows where to go next.<ref>{{Cite|[Not yet...] Oh. That's too bad. But it sounds like you at least know where you need to search next to find her, kwee. That's...something, right?|Machi|SS}}</ref> Machi then thanks Link for helping to reunite him with his friends and then bids farewell.<ref>{{Cite|I'm so glad I've finally been reunited with all my Kikwi friends. It's all thanks to you, koo-weep!|Machi|SS}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|With any luck, hopefully you'll find that girl you've been searching for real soon, koro-koo! Take care, OK?|Machi|SS}}</ref>

==={{TFH|-}}===
{{Main|Forest Temple (Tri Force Heroes)}}
The Forest Temple is the fourth and final [[Level]] of the [[Woodlands]] in {{TFH}}. Its boss is [[Margoma]].

==Other Appearances==
==={{OoT4kMK|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Main|Forest Temple (Ocarina of Time)}}
[[Link]] battles [[Phantom Ganon]] with the [[Bow]] inside the Forest Temple.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{OoT4kGBAC|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Main|Forest Temple (Ocarina of Time)}}
[[Link]] stumbles across a [[Painting]] containing [[Joelle]] while exploring the Forest Temple. Joelle attacks him for his unimpressed reaction to her Painting.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{OoTPtA|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Main|Forest Temple (Ocarina of Time)}}
After obtaining the [[Hookshot]] from [[?]] and the "[[Song of Storms]]" from the [[Phonogram Man]],<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= OoTPtA |publisher= |page= 44}}</ref> [[Link]] travels through the [[Sacred Forest Meadow]] after obtaining the [[Hookshot]].
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{OoT|-}} (Himekawa)===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Main|Forest Temple (Ocarina of Time)}}
After returning to what remains of [[Kokiri Forest]], [[Link]] makes his way to the Forest Temple to battle Phantom Ganon and free Saria.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{TP (Himekawa)|Display}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Main|Forest Temple (Twilight Princess)}}
[[Wolf Link]] is brought to the Forest Temple by Ook, who knocks him unconscious. Here, Wolf Link meets Midna, who followed them and helps him escape.
{{Noncanon|End}}
